paite: TOUPA khut ka tung ah a-om a, TOUPA kha in ahon pikhia a, phaizang laitak ah hon koih a; guh ngen in huai phaizang adim hi.
heading: Guh Keu Phaizang
english: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

paite: Huan alak uah ahon pi vialvial a; phaizang ah guh tampi ana om lemlom a; ngai dih, akeu ngen ahi.
english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai guhte ahing thei diam?" achi hi. Ke'n, "Aw, Toupa PATHIAN, nang na theizaw hi," ka chi hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Thu gen inla, akiang uah, 'Aw, nou guh keute aw, TOUPA thu ngai un.
english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

paite: Hiai guhte kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, noute ah nakna ka lutsak ding a, na hing ding uh.
english: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

paite: Noute ah thagui ka koih ding a, sa in ka hon tuam ding a, vun in ka hon khuh ding; huan na sung uah nakna ka omsak ding a, na hing ding ua, kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh,' chi in," achi hi.
english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

paite: Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka genta a; ka gen leh husa ahong om a, ngai in, aging luilui a, guhte amau kizoppih chiat ah akisutuah khawmta uh.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

paite: Ka etleh ngai in, amau ah thagui ahong om a, sa in atuam a, vun in akhuhta a; nakna bel amau ah a-om nai kei hi.
english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

paite: Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Huih kiang ah thu gen inla, mihing tapa, gen mahmah in, huih kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, nakna, kawlmong li a kipan in hong pai inla, hiai mithahte tung ah nak in, ahintheihna ding un, chi in," achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

paite: Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka gen a, amau ah nakna ahong lut a, ahingta ua, amau khe chiat in ahong dingh ua, sepaihhon thupitak ahong hita hi.
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai guhte Israel inkote pumpi ahi ua; ngai dih, amau, 'Ka guhte uh akeu khin in, ka lamet uh abei khinta, phukmang in ka omta uh,' achi uhi.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

paite: Huaiziak in thu gen inla, akiang uah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ahante uh ka hong ding a, aw, ka mite aw, na han ua kipan ka hon khah ding a; huchi in Israel gam ah ka hon pilut ding hi.
english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

paite: Na hante uh ka hon a, na han ua kipan ka hon pawtsak hun chiang in, aw, ka mite aw, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

paite: Huan noumau ah ka Kha ka koih ding a, na hing ding uh, na gam ngei uah ka hon koih ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita a, ka hih lai ding ahi chih na thei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi," achi hi.
english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
heading: Judah Leh Israel, Lalgam Khat Ah
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: Nang, mihing tapa, chiang khat la inla, atung ah, "Judah leh akithuahpih Israel suante," chih gelh in; chiang dang leng la inla, atung ah, "Joseph leh Ephraim chiang leh akithuahpih Israel inkote tengteng," chih gelh in.
english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

paite: Huan chiangte peh inla, na khut a khat ahihtheihna ding in.
english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

paite: "Hiaite bang chihna ahi ua, na hon kawkmuh kei dia hia?" Na nam tate un na kiang ahon chih uleh, akiang uah,
english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Ephraim leh akithuahpih Israel chite khut a om Joseph chiang ka la ding a, huaite Judah chiang toh ka peh ding a, khat in ka bawl ding a, ka khut ah khat ahong hi ding, na chi ding hi.
english: tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

paite: Chiang, atung a na gelhnate mahmah amitmuh ngei uah na khut ah a-om ding hi.
english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

paite: Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ava tunna gam ua namte lak a kipan Israel tate ka pikhe ding a, ning chih a kipan ka kaikhawm ding a, agam uah ka pikik ding hi.
english: Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.

paite: Huan huai gam, Israel tangte ah nam khat in ka bawl ding a, kumpipa khat avek ua kumpipa ahi dia; huan, nam nih ahi nawnta kei ding ua, vaihawmna gam nih in leng akikhen nawn sam kei ding hi.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

paite: Amilimte uh, athilkihhuaite uh, atatleknate un leng akihihnin ngei nawnta kei ding ua; apuk ua akhelhna nak tengteng ua kipan ka hunkhe ding a, ka khuahsiang ding; huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

paite: Ka nasempa David atung ua kumpipa ahi ding a, avek ua tung ah belamchingtu khat a-om ding; ka thupiakte amang ding ua, ka dan bawlte azui ding ua, azang ding uh.
english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

paite: Ka nasempa Jakob kiang a ka gam piak, na pipute uh na tenna sek ah ateng ding ua; huai ah tangtawn in ateng ding ua, amau leh atate uh, atate uh tate leng; ka nasempa David tangtawn in aheutu uh ahi ding hi.
english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

paite: Huai lou leng amau kiang ah lemna thukhun ka bawl ding a, amau a ding in tangtawn thukhun ahi ding a, akiang uah ka pe ding a, amau ka pungsak ding a, alak uah tangtawn in ka biakbuk ka dingsak ding hi.
english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

paite: Ka biakbuk leng akiang uah a-om ding a, a Pathian uh ka hi ding a, amau ka mite ahi ding uh.
english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

paite: Huan alak ua tangtawn a ding a ka biakbuk adin hun chiang in kei TOUPA, Israel hihsiangthoupa ka hi chih namte'n athei ding uh, achi, chi in.
english: The nations will know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”
